module: Entry point of the third-party LuaIRC library (IRC client in Lua, adapted for BeamNG). Defines the global module `irc` (`module "irc"` form, Lua 5.1): irc.new(data) creates a client, connect() opens the TCP socket (SSL possible via libs/luasec/ssl), sends CAP/NICK/USER and loops until authentication. Loads irc.util, irc.asyncoperations and irc.handlers. Events are attached with hook(name, id, f); think() must be called regularly to read incoming messages.
usage:
local irc = require("libs/LuaIRC/init")
local c = irc.new({nick = "MyBot"})
c:hook("OnChat", function(user, channel, msg) print(user.nick, msg) end)
c:connect("irc.example.org", 6667)
c:join("#test")
-- then call c:think() every frame
notes: Before connect(), the object has the meta_preconnect metatable: only hook, unhook and connect are usable, any other access to meta methods raises an error.

connect() blocks (30 s timeout by default, then a wait loop with a 0.1 s pause) until the server has replied 001; it returns nothing. On TCP connection failure, it logs an error and returns without raising an error.
In connect(), `success` is assigned without `local` (global variable). If LuaSec is missing, the log passes a useless 4th argument (2).
meta:handle prints unknown IRC commands and their parameters with print.
A hook that returns a truthy value interrupts the chain of the following hooks for that event (invoke returns true).

meta.desc: Metatable of an established IRC connection (after connect()). The sending methods are in asyncoperations.lua.

hook.desc: Registers a function for an event (e.g. OnChat, OnJoin, OnRaw, OnSend, PreRegister, OnConnect, OnDisconnect). If f is omitted, id is used as the function. Returns id (or f).

id.desc: Hook identifier (used by unhook) or the function itself

f.desc: Function called with the event's arguments

unhook.desc: Removes a hook; assert fails if the event has no hook or if the id is unknown.

invoke.desc: Calls the hooks of an event; stops at the first one that returns a truthy value.

returns.desc: true if a hook answered true

disconnect.desc: Clean disconnect: fires OnDisconnect (message, false), sends QUIT then closes the socket.

shutdown.desc: Closes the socket and removes the metatable from the object (it is no longer usable).

think.desc: Reads all available lines on the socket (non-blocking), fires the OnRaw hook then, if it does not return true, processes the line via handle. To be called regularly. Raises an error if the socket is cut.

handle.desc: Runs the irc.handlers handler matching the received command; prints the command if it is unknown.

whois.desc: Sends WHOIS and reads the replies in a blocking way until code 318. Returns a table with userinfo, node, channels, account/registered depending on the server's replies; the other lines received are processed by handle.

returns.desc: Fields userinfo, node, channels, registered, account

topic.desc: Requests a channel's topic (TOPIC command); the reply arrives via the OnTopic hook.

meta_preconnect.desc: Metatable of a client created by irc.new but not yet connected.

__index.desc: Returns hook, unhook or connect; raises an error for any other field that exists in meta (accessible only after connecting).

connect.desc: Opens the TCP connection (optional SSL), sends CAP REQ multi-prefix, fires PreRegister, sends PASS/NICK/USER, then loops on think() until 001 is received before firing OnConnect. Accepts either (host, port), or a table.

_host.desc: Host name, or table {host, port, timeout, password, secure}

new.desc: Creates an unconnected IRC client. data.nick is required (assert) and validated by checkNick; username is "lua" and realname "Lua owns" by default; nickGenerator is defaultNickGenerator; track_users is true by default.
